entries.3de1dd8c79c7dfda: This is the core business of the group, manufacturing and selling various types of ships. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥125,643 million. In addition to its core handysize bulk carriers, it is advancing the transition to a product-mix shipbuilding structure that also includes large bulk carriers. The company and Hakodate Dock Co., Ltd. are responsible for manufacturing and sales.

entries.fbd867be51118a64: This business repairs and dismantles ships. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥20,538 million. It is handled by Sasebo Heavy Industries Co., Ltd. and Hakodate Dock Co., Ltd., which repair domestic naval vessels, patrol vessels and U.S. Navy vessels, and also undertake work on technically demanding civilian ships.
